name: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence (Norway) (2020)
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Government of Norway (Regjeringen) (regjeringen.no) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Government of Norway (Regjeringen) (regjeringen.no).
